info.title: Gauas Kanban Service API
info.description: Comprehensive API documentation for the Gauas Kanban Service - a feature-rich project management system with boards, columns, tickets, and collaboration features.

post.description: Creates a new kanban board with the authenticated user as owner and first member

get.description: Retrieves all boards where the authenticated user is a member
Retrieves board details with columns, tickets, members, and labels

delete.description: Permanently deletes a board and all its data

patch.description: Toggles the archived status of a board

get.description: Search for tickets by title within a specific board
Filter tickets by assignee, label, or status within a specific board

post.description: Creates a new column in a board

get.description: Retrieves column details with all tickets

patch.description: Updates column title and/or WIP limit

delete.description: Deletes a column and all its tickets

patch.description: Changes the position of a column within the board using fractional positioning

post.description: Creates a new ticket in a specific column

get.description: Retrieves ticket details with assignees, labels, and checklists

patch.description: Updates ticket properties like title, description, priority, due date, or status

description.example: Updated ticket description with markdown support

delete.description: Permanently deletes a ticket and all its related data

patch.description: Moves a ticket to a different column and/or position

post.description: Creates a new user in the system
Adds an existing user as a member to a board
Creates a new label for a board
Assigns an existing label to a ticket
Assigns a board member to a ticket

delete.description: Removes a member assignment from a ticket

post.description: Creates a new checklist item for a ticket

patch.description: Updates the status of a checklist item
